assertions: A verified grounded Action Candidate digest, exact scalar arguments, scope and target references are frozen into one review revision.
Action, argument, target, impact or validity changes produce a different revision hash.
Incomplete candidates and missing communication, consequence or financial declarations are blocked.
External, financial, credential, public, unknown and irreversible impact is conservatively escalated.
The result never accepts a reviewer decision, grants authorization, issues a confirmation token or executes an action.
